title: Clifford Realizations of Hyperbolic Cubics
summary: We prove the generalized Lax conjecture for cubics in five variables: their hyperbolicity cones are spectrahedral. Our approach constructs spectrahedral realizations from completely positive maps on Clifford algebras. The construction passes through quaternionic determinantal representations of certain extremal cubics. Convexity of the set of Clifford-realizable cubics then yields the result for all cubics in five variables.
